name: Airport Terminal Pure Coconut Water (Harmless Harvest / Vita Coco)
whyItWorks: Cabin air at 35,000 feet has relative humidity under 15%—dryer than the Sahara Desert. Pure coconut water provides natural bioavailable potassium, magnesium, and sodium to combat travel dehydration without acidic citric dyes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy a bottle post-security before boarding. Sip at room temperature throughout the flight.
